Adhesive

4. INSTALL UPPER MOULDING
(a) Place the moulding onto the body.
(b) Pry up the clips on the body side and install to the moulding.

(c) Tap the moulding with your hand to fasten the clips at the glass edge.
At the same time, install the fasteners by tapping them by hand.

(d) If the moulding is not at the same level as the body, insert a scraper between them and tap on the moulding while pushing on the fastener.

5. INSTALL SIDE MOULDING IN SAME MANNER AS FOR UPPER MOULDING

6. INSTALL JOINT COVER
(a) Slide the side moulding down.
(b) Install the joint cover to the upper moulding.
(c) Connect the side moulding into the joint cover.

7. INSTALL SCREW ON MOULDING

8. INSTALL WIPER ARM
